name: audiform
description: Free, open-source multitrack audio editor. Based on Altered Audio Editor by The GCRN.
author: The Audiform contributors (based on Altered Audio Editor by The GeekCast Radio Network, LLC)

scripts.check: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/check-headers.mjs && node scripts/check-privacy.mjs && node scripts/check-private-terms.mjs
